# SEC filing-index ingestion — Stage 1 readiness finding

## 1. Conclusion, endpoint, authority and supported boundary

**The bounded source/runtime feasibility conclusion is supported; this corrected readiness candidate awaits scoped re-review, final freeze and exact-revision owner acceptance. Stage 1 is incomplete.** The evidence establishes a viable exact isolated runtime and a documented provider design, with every required owner selection recorded. It establishes no production ingestion coverage or effective Azure deployment behavior. Final whole-branch review identified P2 claim-index coverage and P3 selection wording corrections; this batch addresses them and awaits scoped re-review. The subsequent completion gate is Lowell Mason's explicit acceptance of the reviewed finding revision, date and limitations; §9 remains pending. The line-by-line [readiness checklist](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/readiness-checklist.md) distinguishes the satisfied technical prerequisites from this blocking completion gate.

Evaluation: **2026-10-05 America/New_York**, assembled 2026-10-06 UTC. The investigation pinned **2026 Q4**, latest closed quarter **2026 Q3**: 2010 Q1–2026 Q4 contains **68 intended units**, of which 2015 Q1–2026 Q4 contains **48 development units**. Future runs resolve and pin their own endpoint; a newly opened quarter needs discovery and format validation. E-PROTECTION/E-T2-COVERAGE and [baseline](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/baseline.md), [quarterly inventory](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/quarterly.csv) supply the accounting.

Contract authority is the accepted [parent spec](sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md) SHA-256 `6c4f27aead06659864497c737ddd8f29a07d4ee0f671cd5c22529da857e89b93`, [ADR](sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md) `55852d3b85ba2e6f7c0cbf1559615e769f751fda01a7f781fb5e73ff6a337807` and approved [Stage 1 spec](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/versions/approved-sec-filing-index-ingestion-stage-1-spec-bb28b0c27646d4f7b15669660e56c230d3247148966e3b075b96ca196a0b5140.md) `bb28b0c27646d4f7b15669660e56c230d3247148966e3b075b96ca196a0b5140`, accepted 2026-10-05. Approval/current HEAD is `321c93af78b54c7e63efbb0e69252c69a238fec6`. E-PROTECTION and fresh E-T6-INTEGRITY recheck these bytes against the approval reference. No parent contract was revised by the investigation.

The supported investigation boundary is quarterly ZIP with exactly one DEFLATE `master.idx` member and plain daily IDX, with the two fully observed text families described in §3, using the exact Linux amd64 combination in §4 and the documented Blob/Table lifecycle in §5. Filing indexes, metadata ETL and reconciliation remain the workload; one future package is `packages/sec-edgar-ingest/`, distribution/CLI `sec-edgar-ingest`, import `sec_edgar_ingest` (parent §§2, 4.1, 4.9; ADR Decision). No production parser, golden fixture suite, collector/catalog, worker image, Bicep definitions, deployment, publication or trigger activation is delivered here. Scaffolds and workspace repairs belong to Stage 2. This finding supplies no later-stage plan or additional SEC/compute authority.

Material claims below cite evidence IDs in the retained [index](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/index.csv) and direct artifacts. The append-only correction supplies categorized claims and [claim/requirement coverage](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/final-fix/coverage.md); exact source artifacts, hashes and original receipt-time semantics are in [claim provenance](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/final-fix/claim-provenance.json). The five categories are now independently represented in the index: verified documentation, source/probe observation, owner decision, assumption and reserved Stage 7 check. Historical pending text remains history; current acceptance is determined by the exact receipts, never silence or a prior approval.

The two selected families are:

- Quarterly: ZIP, exactly one DEFLATE member `master.idx`; strict ASCII, CRLF, `CIK|Company Name|Form Type|Date Filed|Filename`, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates.
- Daily: plain IDX, strict ASCII, LF, `CIK|Company Name|Form Type|Date Filed|File Name`, compact `YYYYMMDD` dates. Filing dates can precede the filename and cross output quarters: 2026-09-30 includes 2025-08-25; valid filing date determines output quarter. A filename-equality filter would lose valid observations.

Both full bounded scans found five pipe-separated fields and `edgar/data/<CIK>/<10>-<2>-<6>.txt` accession paths. Original ZIP bytes remain hash-named `.zip`; decoded IDX derivatives are distinct. Plain daily originals remain `.idx`. Parent §§4.5–4.6 require original-byte replay and content/generation-addressed immutable inputs, not replacing an archive with its decoded member because an example raw path ends `master.idx`. Raw naming here is local evidence naming, no production contract revision. Parent §4.4's logical key/nullable accession, closed-quarter hash/candidate-bound human withdrawal approval and open-quarter absence safeguards remain unchanged. Publication requires complete immutable generations and a conditional active-pointer change; readers follow that pointer/manifest, never a glob. Per-quarter atomicity, pinned source worksets and no Blob/Table transaction remain parent contracts.

Blob client and ADF result GET explicitly pin **2026-04-06** data-plane version with Blob12.31.0; SDK default is newer, so explicit selection matters. Table12.7.0 explicitly pins **2020-12-06**. All stored files use Blob creation/upload/block commit/read throughout their lifecycle, preventing DFS-created-file block overwrite mixing. No DFS rename/recursive-delete dependency. Lease acquire/renew/release is on the Blob sentinel; documented finite duration15–60s or infinite does not fence SEC requests or Table entities. Real ETag/If-Match conditional Table update yields204 or stale412; missing/wildcard If-Match/upsert is not CAS. Parent lease-loss/takeover, immutable publication and no cross-service transaction remain application obligations.

Start200 returns execution id/name; validate exact accepted subscription/RG/job path, persist run/command/attempt/workset/hash/digest and use exact GET. Start202 requires validated HTTPS `management.azure.com` async Location/Retry-After, returned version and exact path; never forward a token to arbitrary hosts/redirects. Async-operation completion is separate from exact execution and matching successful immutable worker result. ADF Web `turnOffAsync=true`, retry0 makes observation application-owned; documented JSON-object/4MB constraints mean missing202 body/header exposure is still Stage7 proof. No correlation by newest execution/time/list order. Missing/unexpected response/status/deadline is execution_unknown, operator recovery, no automatic relaunch. Accepted D18 observer deadline does not terminate a job. Related exact async status/results Actions require subscription scope outside job/RG ancestry; actual returned routes/headers/effective permissions remain Stage7.

Seven documented labels have conservative policies: **Running/Processing** continue bounded polling; **Succeeded** is candidate success only with exact matching durable success; **Failed** is failed, replay only if positively confirmed transient; **Stopped** unsuccessful; **Degraded/Unknown**, unrecognized enums and unavailable GET never pass or authorize replay. Provider meaning cells merely repeat labels, so timestamps/message/reason cannot imply terminal success. All actual selected-version start/async/state/result cases and ambiguous-start fault behavior remain S7-06–10.

E-T5-5F1AAA96CF8302C6 [literal permission matrix](evidence/sec-filing-index-ingestion/stage-1/provider/task5-permissions/permissions-source-notes.md) and bootstrap supplement specify identity/audience/operation/scope. ADF SAMI: four exact Jobs read/start/execution/list Actions at job, two location async-read Actions at subscription, Blob read at results. Worker UAMI: Blob read/write at raw/worksets/results/quarantine/generations/manifests/locks; Table entity read/add/update at SourceState/Attempts/ActivePointers/Approvals; optional approval evidence Blob read. Pull UAMI: AcrPull at dedicated registry. Lowell: scoped ActivePointers/entity read and manifests/generations Blob read, separate approval/rollback data writes plus broad selected management/bootstrap authority. ARM audience `https://management.azure.com/`, Storage `https://storage.azure.com/`, ACR general `https://containerregistry.azure.net/` with ARM-token acceptance for MI integration.

Trust limits are material: ADF start can override templates and use worker identities, so start authority is trusted at worker privilege. Table grants apply to all entities, not approved rows/hash predicates; worker approval writes cover candidate/request/consumption bookkeeping and may never manufacture independently attributable human approval. Application validation must reject self-created/reused/mismatched approval before closed-quarter removal. Lowell's aggregate reader/approval/management grants include writes; a read-only reader role does not promise mutation denial. Contributor can alter identity-bearing jobs/retrieve keys. RBAC proves none of immutable content, publication predicates or human approval correctness; S7-02/12/13/21 checks remain mandatory.

Public paths require valid DNS/TLS/outbound443/firewalls: SEC (closed now), Blob/Table, ARM validated async, Entra/MI host auth, ACR registry/data/layer endpoints and telemetry; DFS not selected. MI never bypasses network policy. Exact official regional product evidence has **27 GA rows** across eastus/eastus2/centralus; Jobs/Consumption product mapping uses documented shared environment/general-purpose supported-region guidance, no invented matrix SKU. Account HNS+Table coexistence is a combined GPv2 inference, no explicit HNS-specific sentence or runtime proof. Selected subscription registration/profile/quota/capacity/policy, actual account compatibility and network remain S7-01/03/14.
